spots.name: Zaatar W Zeit
spots.note: Manakish around the clock. The cheapest good idea here.

spots.name: Embassy
spots.note: Late and loud. Doors at eight.

spots.name: Awani
spots.note: Levantine mezze from breakfast to midnight.

spots.name: Shake Shack
spots.note: Reliable at 2am when nothing else on the beach is.

spots.name: House of Pops
spots.note: Fruit ice pops, no refined sugar. Good in 40 degree heat.

spots.name: Aprons & Hammers
spots.note: Seafood you smash open yourself. Plastic sheeting on the table.

spots.name: Bar 44
spots.note: Forty-fourth floor. Marina panorama, jazz most nights.

spots.name: The Maine Oyster Bar and Grill
spots.note: Dark wood brasserie. Oysters and a proper burger.

spots.name: P.F. Chang's
spots.note: Lettuce wraps and a long cocktail list.

spots.name: S'wich
spots.note: Sandwiches until midnight, counter service, no fuss.

spots.name: Pure Sky Lounge & Dining
spots.note: Thirty-five floors up. The whole coastline is the view.

spots.name: Bosporus
spots.note: Turkish, generous, open past midnight. Get the pide.

spots.name: Eat Greek Kouzina
spots.note: Plate-smashing on busy nights. The saganaki arrives on fire.

spots.name: Bluewaters Island
spots.note: Man-made island under the wheel. Restaurants ring the promenade.

spots.name: Fresh Fish
spots.note: Pick from the ice, they grill it. Open till 3am.

spots.name: Paavo's Pizza
spots.note: Runs to 4am at the weekend. Sold by the slice.

spots.name: Tandoori Junction
spots.note: North Indian, generous portions, quick service.

spots.name: Sweetheart Kitchen
spots.note: Delivery kitchen with a hatch. Open 24 hours.

spots.name: Stanley
spots.note: All-day menu, big windows, good for a long lunch.

spots.name: Dinner In The Sky
spots.note: A table winched into the air on a crane. Exactly as advertised.

spots.name: Buddha Bar
spots.note: Cavernous, red-lit, a giant Buddha over the room. Book or queue.

spots.name: Grand Grill Steakhouse
spots.note: Straightforward steak, no theatre, fair prices.

spots.name: San Wan Hand Pulled Noodles
spots.note: Noodles pulled to order behind glass. Closes between services.

spots.name: % Arabica
spots.note: Kyoto roaster, minimalist counter, consistently the best flat white on The Walk.

spots.name: Buffalo Wild Wings
spots.note: Screens on every wall. Where the match gets watched.

spots.name: Bake My Day
spots.note: Pastry case worth crossing the road for. Open till midnight.

spots.name: Kimuraya
spots.note: Tiny Japanese counter. Sit at the bar, order the katsu.

spots.name: Claw BBQ Crabshack Grill - JBR
spots.note: Mallets, bibs, buckets of crab. Loud and worth it.

spots.name: Bliss Lounge
spots.note: Beachfront cushions, shisha, sea breeze. Sunset onward.

spots.name: Villa Verona
spots.note: Italian, closes mid-afternoon at the weekend. Check before you walk.

spots.name: Pechka Cafe and Bakery
spots.note: Eastern European bakery. Coffee and something buttery.

spots.name: Marbar Rooftop Tapas Bar
spots.note: Small rooftop, small plates, marina lights below.

spots.name: Carluccio's
spots.note: Italian deli-cafe. Morning only, closes at noon.

spots.name: Jumeirah Lakes Towers Park
spots.note: Lawns and a running loop. Busiest after sundown.

spots.name: Ain Dubai
spots.note: The largest observation wheel built. Thirty-eight minutes a rotation.

spots.name: Smoky Beach
spots.note: Feet in the sand, grill smoke, no reservation.
